articles.title: Cboe, S&P Dow Jones may explore tokenized options contracts under extended licensing deal
articles.snippet: The agreement opens the door to tokenized derivatives as some of Wall Street's biggest institutions, including Nasdaq, NYSE and DTCC, move traditional markets onchain.

articles.title: Ethereum users get another way to pay privately as zk.money returns after three years
articles.snippet: The relaunched wallet hides payments made on the Aztec Network, while deposits from Ethereum remain visible.

articles.title: Blockchain.com targets $500 million IPO this year at up to $6 billion valuation
articles.snippet: The London-based crypto services company confidentially filed for an initial public offering with the Securities and Exchange Commission earlier this year.

articles.title: Bitcoin is on track to shatter a major decade-long streak as September gains surge
articles.snippet: Bitcoin is on track for a third straight monthly gain, but higher yields, oil prices and two major November events could test its Q4 momentum.

articles.title: Anthropic plans to spend $518 billion on AI infrastructure. Pre-IPO perps barely blink.
articles.snippet: Anthropic's prospectus seen by Reuters shows big spending plans despite heavy losses. Still, pre-IPO perps barely moved on cryptocurrency exchanges.
